name: Classrooms
shortDescription: Bright smart classrooms where everyday learning happens.
detailedDescription: The classroom wing has bright, airy rooms equipped with smart boards. Desks can be arranged for group work, and display walls show student projects. Each classroom is designed to support discussion, collaboration and hands-on learning.

interestingFacts: Smart boards let teachers show videos, diagrams and live demonstrations.
Desks can be rearranged in minutes for group projects.

hotspots.title: Smart Classroom Features
hotspots.description: Each room has a smart board for interactive lessons, videos and quizzes, plus space for display of student work.

hotspots.title: Student Activities
hotspots.description: Students take part in debates, presentations and group projects inside the classroom.

hotspots.title: Learning Programs
hotspots.description: Learning programs combine textbooks with projects, reading time and activity-based learning.

aiContext: Classrooms are in the wing connected to the Main Building. The library is the next stop.
